svg.title: last_event_by_entity while jobs are expanded
svg.desc: Six events are added in order. For each, the table shows the map lookup (ChainAfterLastEntityEvent), the leaf edges (OrderAfterJobLeafEvents), the bay edge (OrderAfterBayAndChargerEvents) and the map afterwards; the DAG below colours each edge by the helper that added it.

g.text: The map holds, for each AGV, tray, bay and VECS, the last event that touched it. ChainAfterLastEntityEvent(key, e) adds last[key] -> e if there is an entry, then sets

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: last[key] = e; AddChainedEvent(e) adds e and does this for e's own entity.
